name: foreground-balanced sampling
hypothesis: Increasing exposure to annotation-positive slices may reduce missed foreground; it may also increase false positives. This is unproven.

decision_rule.primary: mean per-patient native Dice must exceed baseline
guardrails: mean native IoU must not decrease
mean false-positive volume must not increase
no patient Dice decrease greater than 0.05
decision_rule.if_failed: retain baseline and report negative result
decision_rule.if_passed: candidate for paired three-seed confirmation, not clinical or automatic deployment approval

limits: cannot infer clinical safety or broader performance
